blocks.text: Whetstone mailbox cutover to Exchange Online, v1 requirements

This is the working cut for WTS-4418 on March 14, 2023. Brett Holtz asked for a written bound after the current path (Exchange 2016 on mail-01.whetstone.internal, 214 user boxes, 37 shared, Outlook anywhere through helpdesk.whetstone.internal) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, IT Support Intern, writing for Brett Holtz, Carla Nguyen, and Owen Briggs. Primary host mail-01.whetstone.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on Nimbus Mail tenant cutover, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Migrate 214 user mailboxes to Exchange Online. Leave 37 shared boxes on mail-01.whetstone.internal until Rita Cho finishes the shift-note owner list. Reject Nimbus Mail ($18.4k, Global Admin for 11 days). I am not restating a hallway yes. Nimbus Mail tenant cutover is out because Quote dated January 18 asked for Global Admin for 11 days and had no plant OU filter. Brett killed it in the February 9 room. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at users=214, shared=37, lag=4.6, cost=18.4, days=11, stale=38.2, weeks=6.5, cpu=61.4. Sibling tickets WTS-REQ-2023-011 and WTS-4418-DBA. I will not reopen Nimbus Mail tenant cutover in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Carla Nguyen is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
